Title: Serverspace Announces New Data Centres Worldwide
# Serverspace Announces New Data Centres Worldwide. - April 21, 2023) - Serverspace, a leading cloud provider, is proud to announce the hardware placement in a new data center in Toronto, Canada. This facility marks the sixth location for Serverspace's global expansion, with existing data centers in five other countries. The equipment at the new data center is housed in Tier III certified facility called Cologix TOR 3, located at 905 King Street in downtown Toronto. Cloud technology has emerged as a game-changer in recent years, providing solutions to various problems with cost and inefficiency faced by businesses and individuals using non-cloud data systems. Some of the significant advantages of cloud technology include cost and infrastructure management, scalability, accessibility, data security, collaboration, software updates, and disaster recovery. Since the data center's launch, users have deployed 24,000 servers. "Connecting to our high-end data center infrastructure allows Serverspace to be in demand around the world.". Serverspace's expansion in Toronto is part of its ongoing commitment to providing reliable and scalable cloud solutions to businesses worldwide. Serverspace is a cloud provider has been in the international market for 14 years. With over 120,000 customers and six data centers located all around the globe, Serverspace provides cloud infrastructure rental services, administration, CDN, network services, and tools for automating infrastructure management via API, CLI, and Terraform. Recently, Serverspace was named a Momentum Leader in G2's Spring report, showcasing its commitment to providing reliable and scalable cloud solutions to businesses worldwide. Serverspace's goal is to listen to its customers and provide highly reliable, simple, and available cloud infrastructure to everyone, allowing businesses to focus on their core competencies and achieve success. For those interested in learning more about cloud infrastructure, Serverspace offers a blog and news section, customer stories, and tutorials. They also provide solutions for WordPress Hosting, Application Hosting, Web Hosting, Cloud for Startups, Cloud for E-commerce, and Big Data computing. Regarding the future of Serverspace's services, Dmitry Volkov adds, "This year, we will open 5 more data centers in EMEA, ATP, and LAD regions. In these data centers, it will be possible to deploy any provider service, including cloud servers and a recently released CDN.

facts: Serverspace is an international cloud provider offering automated virtual infrastructure deployment.
Linux- or Windows-based virtual servers can be deployed in less than a minute.
Serverspace operates within the ITGLOBAL.COM Group of Companies and is headquartered in Amsterdam, Netherlands.
Serverspace data centers correspond to Tier III reliability standards.
Serverspace has data centers across countries including the Netherlands, the USA, Canada, Kazakhstan, Turkey, the UAE, and Brazil.
pros: Fast automated deployment of Linux or Windows servers in less than 1 minute.
10 Gbps DDoS filtering included without additional charge.
Flexible billing allowing users to pause servers and pay only for disk/IP, with 10-minute or hourly increments.
Tier III data center reliability minimizing downtime.
cons: Basic backups are not included in the standard VPS cost and require a separate fee.
Additional IPv4 addresses require an extra fee, and free blocks may temporarily run out.
